mentions.name: Nile (getnile.ai)
mentions.description: A single tool for doing data engineering work, which abstracts away tedious, repetitive parts of the job (e.g. creating new tables) so users can focus on higher-level work like analysis. Includes a completely free version that runs locally on your computer.
mentions.problem: A lot of data engineering work is non-differentiated across companies; people spend time on repetitive tasks instead of higher-level work like analysis.
mentions.audience: Data engineers and data teams looking to spend less time on repetitive work
mentions.source_excerpt:
My friends and I built a way for you to do all your data engineering work with just one tool.

https://getnile.ai
